According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $A$ is a matrix with $n$ columns, then 

$$
\text{rank}(A)+\text{nullity}(A)=n.
$$

For the given matrix, we have $n=10.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(A)+\text{nullity}(A) & =n \\ 1+\text{nullity}(A) & =10 \\ \text{nullity}(A) & =10-1 \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
